messages:
zoe: Cutoff in ~6h. Need a version bump + changelog entry + quick security thumbs + a smoke run before we cut. Who can pair for tag + docs? I can own release notes if someone takes tests.
anya: I can do the version bump and push the tag. Which branch should I bump — main or release/v0.23?
zoe: release/v0.23 — that's where the stabilizations landed. Bump to v0.23.4.
sam: I'll draft the changelog. Include webhook delivery fix and kafka retry change. Will post a snippet in a sec.
tom: I can run the smoke on staging at 15:00 UTC. Ping me when tag is up.
security-reviews-bot: Automated security scan complete for branch release/v0.23 at 1769123456. No new high-severity findings. Report: https://redwood.ci/reports/1769123456
anya: Bump command I'll run: `git checkout release/v0.23 && git pull origin release/v0.23 && git tag -a v0.23.4 -m "v0.23.4" && git push origin v0.23.4`
anya: Also updating package.json and helm chart values. Opening PR with the changelog snippet and version bump now (WIP).
sam: Changelog snippet I'm dropping into the PR description:
```
### v0.23.4 (2026-03-17)
- Fix: webhook delivery backoff behavior
- Perf: reduce embedding cache spike on cold start
- Ops: kafka consumer retry configuration added
```
zoe: Perfect. @tom when smoke passes, I'll kick the cut. @release-bot can you schedule a dry run and canary? :pray:
release-bot: Dry-run scheduled for 2026-03-17T15:00:00Z. Canary: 5% on dedicated pool. I will post the dry-run results here after completion.
tom: Smoke run started -> a transient 502 on /api/events, retried and green on rerun. All critical flows exercised: auth, inference route, webhooks. :white_check_mark:
zoe: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll cut in 15m unless anyone objects. If you want to pair on the tag, ping @anya and she'll coordinate the PR -> tag flow.
anya: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821 — includes bump, changelog, helm value. Tagging CI watchers.
sam: Reviewed changelog in PR, left one minor wording nit. Otherwise lgtm.
zoe: Cool. Proceeding with final cut at 15:15 UTC if no blockers.
tom: Standing by for the notify.
release-bot: Cut plan: tag v0.23.4 -> promote canary -> wait 10 min -> full rollout. Notifying on success/failure channels.
zoe: Thanks all. I'll post post-cut smoke results and upload the release notes here.
